{{Quote|Can you do something for me? I've noticed some of the Meatlumps here in the hideout are angry for some reason. Can you cheer them up for me?|Balia Alloo, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TAM" />}}
'''Balia Alloo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Alloo operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:TAM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Balia Alloo noticed that many of her fellow Meatlumps had suddenly become angry. Alloo offered the job of cheering up her comrades to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who infiltrated the hideout. The spacer accepted the task of motivating the Meatlumps, many of which desired physical contact or recognition for their accomplishments. To that end, the spacer searched the hideout for at least a dozen angry Meatlumps, offering hugs, smiles, applause, and other signs of encouragement.<ref name="SWG:TAM" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateMeatlumpHideout.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Balia Alloo]]
Balia Alloo appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TAM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Balia Alloo was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

During each server reset, Balia Alloo's gender and appearance was randomized, but Alloo consistently appeared as a Human.<ref name="SWG:TAM" />
